hypothesis: Identifier-aware source acquisition improves attempt-level final-context accuracy while reducing known model tokens and measured duration against native convergence across four fresh repositories.
selection_rule: Read only the eight source-only parquet columns, exclude every previously exposed G01 task ID, SHA-256-sort IDs within each repository, and take the first title with a distinctive code token: an explicit flag, snake_case identifier, internal camelCase identifier, or uppercase API acronym. Confirm all four base commits exist in the pinned repository caches before freezing. Never inspect gold_context, patch, or test_patch during selection.
decision_rule: Run all four frozen matched pairs regardless of early outcomes. Seal each arm's final prediction or exact completed no-final-context result before scoring. Use the pinned native scorer only for final-context predictions. Under the predeclared attempt-level policy, assign Span-F1 and File-F1 zero only to completed run_error attempts with exact instrument.no-final-context and known model-token receipts; provider or infrastructure errors invalidate a pair. Aggregate pass requires all four pairs valid, candidate macro Span-F1 and File-F1 strictly above control, total known model tokens and measured duration strictly below control, and at most one Span-F1 regression. Report native-scored and policy-zero arms separately.
claim_ceiling: Four-task cross-language attempt-level G01 result for this identifier-aware arm only. Policy zeros are not native ContextBench scores; this is not full ContextBench or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
